{{Quote|You place too much faith in your ancient sorcery, Master Skywalker.'' In Running the Blockade: Escape from Yavin'', Captain Solo clearly illustrated the value of a confident approach.|Jae Juun to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="JK" />}}
'''''Running the Blockade: Escape from Yavin''''' was a history documentary made about the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] escape from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. [[Jae Juun]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], had seen this film.<ref name="JK" />
